ports.note: Gigabit Ethernet, 64x64 Dante channels @48kHz, AES67 support

slots.label: Input connector card slot (field-swappable)
slots.note: 8, 16, 24 or 32 4K60p inputs via 2, 4, 6 or 8 cards. Card options: 4x DisplayPort 1.2/1.4, 4x HDMI 2.0, 4x HDMI 2.0 over optical fiber, 4x 12G-SDI (also 3G/6G), 4x 12G-SFP non-MSA, 4x 12G-SDI + 1x 2.5GbE NDI, 4x SDVoE, 8x HDMI 1.4, 8x 3G-SDI, 4x 25GbE SFP (ST 2110).

slots.label: Output connector card slot (field-swappable)
slots.note: Up to 24 4K60p outputs via 6 cards. Card options: 4x DisplayPort 1.2, 4x HDMI 2.0, 4x HDMI 2.0 over optical fiber, 4x 12G-SDI (also 3G/6G), 4x 12G-SFP non-MSA, 4x SDVoE, 4x 25GbE SFP (ST 2110), 6x 40G QSFP+ (Link).
